items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Exact decision: block security-sensitive releases, gated public exposure, and go-live decisions; conditionally allow only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no completed run; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security sitefacts are unknown across 61 managed sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release integrity, dependency provenance, TLS beyond limited HTTPS checks, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 35 passes, 20 fails, and 6 unknowns across 61 sites, but does not establish security clearance. Risk severity is high for go-live, public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; medium for strictly contained reversible growth. Do not claim certification or a clean bill of health. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix only; do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, alter permissions/configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence work. Record dated authorized evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release/deploy controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain provenance, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Preserve the private/preview-only gate until material controls are evidenced.
